Judgment calls: (a) ADDED COMPONENT id 18, Zener Diode at ~(207,141). A zener symbol (triangle + bent cathode bar) labelled '5V' is unmistakably drawn on rung C2 between R0xC2 and R1xC2, exactly filling the one empty slot in the otherwise complete 2x5 component mesh, and no entry in the published inventory covers that location (nearest bboxes are Inductor 8 and Capacitor 9, both well clear). Treating it as bare wire would have wrongly merged n2 with net 0. bbox is my estimate from the ink. (b) GND 14 (bbox centre (377,491)) is NOT drawn anywhere in the 512x512 frame - rows below y=462 in that column are completely blank, so the symbol was lost to the preprocessing crop. The only open wire end in that region is the bottom of resistor 15's rung, which dies at (393,462) directly above GND 14's bbox; GND 14 is therefore attached there, making Resistor 15 a shunt from n5 to ground. It is NOT marked unconnected. (e) Tier-2 sim finding, kept deliberately: net n6 has no DC path to ground. It is the corner where I-DC 0 meets Capacitor 10, and both of those are DC opens. That is exactly what the ink shows (clean corner at (8,241), no third branch), and a current source feeding a capacitor is a normal AC textbook node. (f) 2-terminal ordering convention: index 0 = the upper/left end as drawn (smaller s along a rail, smaller t down a rung); order does not affect any metric.
